title: Geography of the British Isles (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Odpowiedz na pytania (1.1.-1.5.) dotyczace wiedzy o krajach anglojezycznych. Odpowiadaj po angielsku. W pytaniach oznaczonych 2 pkt nalezy podac dwie informacje.

items.question: What is the longest river in the United Kingdom?
Which sea separates Great Britain from Ireland?
Which independent country occupies most of the island of Ireland? Which part of the island belongs to the United Kingdom?
What is the highest mountain in Wales?
Which English county is traditionally called 'the Garden of England'?
